heatmapchart.applicationDescription: The Updates page uses a full-year calendar of real daily Git commits. Calendar cells and the commit list share the visitor's time zone; selecting a day shows all its commits. Future dates stay blank. Incomplete history is shown as unavailable, rather than zero activity.
heatmapchart.contract: Input is week columns containing dated bins, not a numeric matrix or an automatic aggregation. weekStartDay rotates display rows without changing date identity. Default fluid layout, 2px gaps, 2px corners and 1600ms entrance. Thresholds remain <=0, 1, 2, 3, >=4; shades derive from chart-1 and muted. Pass the same levelStyles to cells/chart and external legend. Every instance owns its texture IDs.
heatmapchart.keyboard: Tab enters once; arrows, Home and End inspect data, Escape or blur clears the tooltip. When onCellSelect is supplied, click/tap or Enter/Space selects the inspected bin. Reduced motion disables decorative loops. ChartLegend layout/overflow are API options; inline/collapse fits multiple entries and folds overflow.
heatmapchart.compatibility: Import shared tooltip and legend from chart-core. Existing chart/Recharts and chart-primitives APIs remain available with their own contracts.
